Question 5
?

Which of the following gives the line integral of the function f(x,y)=3−y2, traversed once along the circle C with equation x2+y2=9?

a
3∫02π(1−3cos2⁡t)dt
b
9∫02π(1−3sin2⁡t)dt
c
9∫02πcos2⁡tdt
d
9∫02π(3−sin2⁡t)dt
e
3∫02πcos⁡tdt
